verdict.rationale: Bento documents a dashboard and out-of-the-box views of cost per run, tool failure rates, drift and regressions. Its CLI can also 'pull analytics'. None of the evidence shows users can build custom dashboards or choose panels over latency, error, cost and eval-score metrics. Fixed built-in views and exporting analytics for external charting are adjacent features or user-side workarounds, not the requested capability.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can build custom dashboards over latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics
